title: Python: Sets
description: Write a Python program that demonstrates set operations: union, intersection, difference, and symmetric difference.

codeTemplate.py:
a = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
b = {4, 5, 6, 7, 8}

print(f"A: {a}")
print(f"B: {b}")
print(f"Union: {a | b}")
print(f"Intersection: {a & b}")
print(f"Difference (A-B): {a - b}")
print(f"Symmetric diff: {a ^ b}")
print(f"Is subset: {a <= b}")

c = {1, 2, 3}
print(f"C subset of A: {c <= a}")
c.add(99)
print(f"C after add: {c}")

verificationTest: output.includes('Union: {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}') && output.includes('Intersection: {4, 5}') && output.includes('Is subset: False') && output.includes('C subset of A: True')
hints: Sets are unordered collections of unique elements: `{1, 2, 3}`
